gui.simpleraces.human_select.tooltip_dwa:
- Humans have no innate magical or bodily advantages
- Their defining trait is endurance: sprinting does not consume hunger
- A human grows strong not through a preset racial gift, but through slowly adapting to the style they practice most
gui.simpleraces.human_select.tooltip_pas:
- Hidden proficiencies awaken over time as the human repeats the same kind of activity again and again
- Digging for long enough very slowly improves mining speed
- Repeated successful hits with the same weapon category slightly increase damage with that category
- Frequent shooting gradually improves arrow travel and effective range
- These bonuses grow very slowly and stay intentionally small, so they support normal progression instead of replacing it
gui.simpleraces.gargoyle_select.tooltip_:
- Changes stance through actions, not buttons
- Switching stances grants a short body-rebuild bonus
- Staying too long in one stance causes Petrification
- Stoneguard turns you into a heavy statue: high defense, narrow vision and a delayed break into Talon
- Talon is the hunting stance built around spacing, Quarry Mark and clean Rake hits

- Stoneguard activates after standing still for about 6 seconds. It heavily reduces incoming damage, narrows vision and slows movement, while breaking out into Talon takes 3 seconds.
- Talon activates after a sprint hit or after leaving Stoneguard. The first target in this stance gets Quarry Mark, and hits change value depending on distance: weak up close, normal at mid range and strongest at long range with Rake.
- Spirewing activates from an aerial attack. It grants elytra-like gliding on a double jump in the air, widens vision and boosts dive attacks, but leaves you fragile.
- Grotesque activates if the gargoyle is crouching, has not attacked for about 1.5 seconds and then takes a hit. It opens a Riposte window; a successful counter frightens the target, applies Quarry Mark II and throws the gargoyle into Talon.
- The race is strongest when it rotates stances well. Staying in one form too long builds Petrification and weakens the gargoyle.
gui.simpleraces.race_select.tooltip_diff:
Difficulty scale
Shows how demanding the race is to master.
gui.simpleraces.dwarf_select.tooltip_dif:
Difficulty: 1/4
One of the easiest races to learn. Dwarf relies on straightforward passive strengths and forgives mistakes well.
gui.simpleraces.elf_select.tooltip_diffi:
Difficulty: 1/4
A very accessible race with clear strengths. Elf works well even without precise micromanagement.
gui.simpleraces.merfolk_select.tooltip_d:
Difficulty: 3/4
Requires good positioning. Merfolk is extremely strong in water, but its weaknesses on land must be managed constantly.
gui.simpleraces.orc_select.tooltip_diffi:
Difficulty: 3/4
A race built around tempo and risk. Orc is powerful if you know when to enter rage and how to avoid the punishment after it.
gui.simpleraces.dragon_select.tooltip_di:
Difficulty: 3/4
Dragon has explosive power spikes, but they need control. Overheat and water vulnerability punish sloppy play.
gui.simpleraces.fairy_select.tooltip_dif:
Difficulty: 4/4
A very demanding race. Fairy depends on positioning, flight timing, and careful survival with a tiny health pool.
gui.simpleraces.serpentin_select.tooltip:
Difficulty: 4/4
Serpentin shines through effects and alchemy. Without preparation and good planning, it feels much weaker.
gui.simpleraces.werewolf_select.tooltip_:
Difficulty: 2/4
A medium-complexity race. Werewolf asks you to respect time of day and form management, but its core gameplay is easy to grasp.
gui.simpleraces.halfdead_select.tooltip_:
Difficulty: 1/4
One of the most direct races. Halfdead plays through health pool, aura, and finish pressure without a complicated rotation.
gui.simpleraces.gargoyle_select.tooltip_:
Difficulty: 4/4
One of the hardest races in the mod. Gargoyle demands stance awareness, combat rhythm, and constant form switching.
gui.simpleraces.human_select.tooltip_dif:
Difficulty: 2/4
Humans have no built-in combat tricks or strong racial bonuses, so their strength depends much more on gear, experience, and the way you play.
gui.simpleraces.arachna_select.tooltip_d:
Difficulty: 2/4
Needs some adjustment to wall movement and positional weaknesses, but overall it is learned fairly quickly.
